model: GR200 paperless recorder (Modbus RTU / Modbus TCP)
applies_to: Shinko GR200 paperless recorder with RS-485 Modbus RTU or Ethernet Modbus TCP; manual GR2CE1.
summary: The GR200 is an up-to-18-channel paperless recorder. It is a Modbus RTU slave on RS-485 and also answers Modbus TCP on port 502 over Ethernet. This map covers the read-only measured values and channel status for all 18 channels plus the per-channel range, scaling and decimal point settings needed to interpret them.

addressing.note: Registers are printed as 30xxx/40xxx numbers; the manual says the address in the message is the lower four digits minus 1 (40003 is sent as 0002). The manual's example reads CH2 measured value (30102) at relative address 0065H.

source.title: Instruction Manual Paperless Recorder Communication Functions (RS-485 MODBUS/Ethernet) Type GR200
source.pages: Settings p. 6; addressing p. 13; data format p. 23; maps pp. 24-36

notes: Long (2-register) values such as totalizer counts and totalizing times are left out: the manual says one value spans two registers but never states which word comes first.
Channel setting blocks are 64 registers apart: CH1 starts at 40001, CH2 at 40065 ... CH18 at 41089.
Holding registers are read with function 03 and written with 10H; the map lists no single-register write (06).
Tags, colours, totalizer, alarm, display and network settings are omitted; the manual's Table 2 and Table 5 code lists are not reproduced.
Measured values carry no decimal point; place it from the channel's decimal point setting.

integration.summary: Read input registers 30101-30118 for the measured values and 30131-30148 for channel status in one block each with function 04, and read each channel's decimal point setting once with function 03.
integration.enable: Set MODBUS Station No. (0-255; 0 stops communication), speed and parity on the front panel. For Modbus TCP (port 502) also turn the MODBUS TCP/IP function ON (factory OFF) and cycle power.
quirks: Out-of-range readings come back as 32767 (over), -32767 (under) or -32768 (burnout/error); check the status registers.
The recorder accepts written values outside the setting range without complaint.
setup: Factory defaults: station 1, 19200 bps, odd parity, 8 data bits, 1 stop bit (8 bits and 1 stop bit are fixed). Up to 31 units per RS-485 line.
gotchas: A read is limited to 64 registers per message.
